subject: Mutual Action Plan: Dedicated Capacity kickoff & stakeholder lanes
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Dedicated capacity + initial evaluation plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on the evaluation lead, the throughput targets you care about, and a close timeline. Below is a working charter; I attached a PDF MAP draft with a week-by-week cadence and a simple acceptance checklist.

Quick summary / asks:
- Goal: validate a Dedicated GPU pool for Nebula production workloads (target latency P95 < 120ms, sustained throughput 1.2M tokens/day at 95% availability)
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks staging + 2 weeks production pilot
- Primary metrics: per-request latency, tokens/sec, tail latency, error rate, and cost per 1k tokens
- Acceptance criteria: sustained throughput and SLA metrics met for 10 business days during pilot; sign-off by Nebula Eng + Procurement
- Immediate asks from your side: identify 2 engineering stakeholders for the evaluation (network & app owner), and procurement contact for T&Cs 

Proposed roles (we can modify):
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt (deal owner / MAP lead), Dylan Brooks (infra lead / onboarding), Marissa Cole (CS / success), Monica Patel (pricing & contracts)
- Nebula: Elena Gomez (product exec / sponsor), TBD - App/Infra Owner (technical sign-off), contracts@nebulacorp.com (procurement)

Timeline (draft):
Week 0 (this week) — MAP sign & intake; exchange network/access docs
Week 1 — environment setup (VPC peering / IP allowlist); provisioning of dedicated pool (staging)
Week 2-5 — functional & performance evaluation (baseline + stress); weekly checkpoints
Week 6 — production pilot (smoke + ramp); sign-off and finalize commitment

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (charter & tasks), throughput-baseline.csv (your sample workload against our baseline), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (network & account items)

I'm happy to run a 30-min MAP orientation with your team tomorrow or Monday. What time zone works best for your infra owner?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks, Hannah — this looks like a great starting point.

Quick responses:
- I can be the sponsor and will loop in our infra owner (Raj Singh) and app owner (Priya Rao). Raj's email is raj@nebulacorp.com — I'll add him to thread once I confirm his availability.
- Procurement noted; contracts@nebulacorp.com is on the CC. They'll need the standard SOW + pricing sheet.
- The throughput target you listed is in the ballpark; can your team share a short test plan we can run against a saved traffic trace? That will help our validation.

I'm available Monday 10–11am PT for the MAP orientation. Please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Elena Gomez
VP Product, Nebula Corp
elena@nebulacorp.com

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, contracts@nebulacorp.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Dedicated capacity + initial evaluation plan

Hi Elena & Raj —

Great — thanks for looping Raj in. I've attached the MAP-draft-v1.pdf and a short test plan (throughput-baseline.csv) that describes three traffic profiles we can run in staging: baseline, 3x ramp, and sustained peak. The short steps:

1) Share a 24-hour saved trace (or allow our team to replay a sanitized sample)
2) We provision a dedicated staging pool and run the baseline profile
3) We run the 3x ramp to test autoscaling and tail latency behavior
4) We run a sustained run for 48 hours to validate cost/perf and durability

If Raj can confirm the VPC peering window (we typically ask for a 2-hour maintenance window to validate IP egress and routing), we can aim to start provisioning on Tuesday morning.

I'll set the MAP orientation for Monday 10am PT and send a calendar invite to this thread. Agenda will be: introductions, MAP milestones, technical intake requirements, acceptance criteria, and procurement checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Hannah

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: Dedicated capacity + initial evaluation plan (technical intake)

All — quick technical note to surface ahead of Monday:

- Network: Raj, we'll need two CIDR blocks to be allowlisted and an SSH bastion IP for debug (temporary). If you use restrictive egress, we need a ticket to open TLS outbound to our IP range.
- Data: We recommend replaying a scrubbed trace; if Nebula prefers payload-level redaction, our team can sign an NDA and run the replay internally.
- Metrics & tooling: We'll ship a Prometheus-compatible scrape target and a small agent that captures per-token latency and KV cache hit rates. Plan to push metrics to your monitoring (optional) or share a read-only Grafana link.
- Failure modes to watch: KV cache miss storms during ramp; watch for long-tail latency during cold-starts on large sequence lengths.

I'll be on the Monday call to walk through the onboarding-checklist.xlsx and capacity knobs (batch sizes, max_context, quantization profile).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference
